# Airgain to Participate in the iAccess Alpha Virtual Best Ideas Winter Investment Conference on December 8–9, 2026


November 24, 2026 1:00pm EST


SAN DIEGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Airgain, Inc. (NASDAQ: AIRG), a leading provider of advanced wireless connectivity solutions, today announced that its management will participate in the iAccess Alpha Virtual Best Ideas Winter Investment Conference, taking place December 8–9, 2026. Jacob Suen, President and CEO, will deliver a company presentation at 3:30 p.m. ET on Tuesday, December 8, followed by one-on-one meetings with pre-qualified investors from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. ET on Wednesday, December 9.


iAccess Alpha hosts virtual investor conferences featuring companies recommended by investors. These two-day events include webcast presentations on Day 1, followed by one-on-one meetings between company management teams and pre-qualified investors on Day 2.


To register for the conference and request a one-on-one meeting with Airgain (AIRG), please visit[www.iaccessalpha.com](http://www.iaccessalpha.com/) .


The live webcast of Airgain’s presentation will be available at[https://event.summitcast.com/view/2DCAfwaui6jQyjpHKx2fsJ/JkoFnfZbG8iSvrX8Vvsxts](https://event.summitcast.com/view/2DCAfwaui6jQyjpHKx2fsJ/JkoFnfZbG8iSvrX8Vvsxts) , and a replay will be accessible following the event. The presentation will also be available on the company’s website at[www.airgain.com](http://www.airgain.com/) under the “Events” section.


**About Airgain, Inc.**


Headquartered in San Diego, California, Airgain, Inc. (NASDAQ: AIRG) is a leading provider of advanced wireless connectivity solutions that drive innovation across 5G, IoT, enterprise, automotive, and consumer markets. Airgain simplifies wireless connectivity through integrated, high-performance solutions that help customers connect devices, vehicles, and systems in demanding real-world environments. For more information, visit[www.airgain.com](http://www.airgain.com/) or follow Airgain on LinkedIn and X.
